incident-bot: INCIDENT alert — elevated 5xx + queueing in eu-west affecting economy tier. Pager: @Maya. auto-correlation suggests routing pressure from sudden traffic spike to economy lane. start=1784001234
Maya (SRE): ack, looking. dashboards show queue depth on econ-backend up x5, token rejection rising. pulling routing policy logs now.
Jon (Platform): can we apply a temporary hard cap on economy weight for eu-west and enable per-key throttles? suggest cap to 50r/s region-wide while we triage.
Maya (SRE): on it. running patch to routing control plane:
```
PATCH /v1/routing/policies/region-eu-west HTTP/1.1
Host: control-plane.internal
Content-Type: application/json

{ "economy_weight": 0.0, "rate_limit_per_region": 50 }
```
Maya (SRE): applied. control-plane returned 200. policies now set to econ weight=0, region cap=50.
Alex (SRE): seeing initial drop in 5xx in eu-west from ~8% -> ~3% in 5m. premium lane adding more load (latency +20ms). watch for bleed-through.
Lia (CS): which customers saw errors? we need to notify top impacted customers and update status page.
Maya (SRE): top impacted app ids: acme-shop, betacorp-forms, gamma-search. CS pinged those teams and prep draft for statuspage: "We are investigating elevated errors for requests routed to economy tier in EU-WEST; mitigations applied, no data loss expected."
Jon (Platform): also enforce token-level quota to prevent single bad key from starving lanes. command:
```
POST /v1/quotas/keys/bulk-apply
{ "pattern": "*", "quota_per_minute": 10000, "scope": "economy-eu-west" }
```
Jon (Platform): applied per-key quota for econ scope.
Maya (SRE): quotas in effect. monitoring shows error rate falling to 1.2% over next 12m. queue depth normalizing.
Alex (SRE): recommend partial restore: set econ weight to 0.3 and run canary at 10% traffic for 15m to validate. if errors spike, revert.
Maya (SRE): starting canary now. patch:
```
PATCH /v1/routing/policies/region-eu-west
{ "economy_weight": 0.3, "canary_percent": 10, "canary_window": 900 }
```
Maya (SRE): canary started — directing 10% of eligible econ traffic back.
Lia (CS): CS posting to impacted customers and statuspage: "Mitigations applied; we are gradually restoring traffic. Updates in 30m." Lia adds :phone: to thread.
Alex (SRE): metrics look stable for 6m into canary, error rate steady ~1.1%, latency acceptable. recommend continue ramp to 50% over 30m.
Jon (Platform): create follow-ups: 1) automate per-region emergency caps, 2) alert when econ queue depth > 3x baseline, 3) run DRM on routing policy changes. assigning owner: Jon + Maya.
Maya (SRE): noted. I'll own postmortem and mitigation playbook updates. paging handoff to night oncall @Sam in 2h — leaving runbook notes in incident doc and tickets for action items.
Sam (oncall): ack, will take over at 1804000000 (ETA handoff). will monitor until ramp complete.
incident-bot: metric snapshot: eu-west econ 5xx = 1.0% (was 8.0%), queue depth = 1.2x baseline, premium latency +18ms, customer impact lowering. Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring.
Maya (SRE): closing active pager for now. will escalate if canary shows regression. thanks all :thumbsup:
